# Folia visualizer source

This directory contains adapted visualizer source from:

- Project: `chthollyphile/folia-major`
- Upstream commit: `b3d70e93a10bf975113cf5ff033b472f2ffd5688`
- Upstream license: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0
- Source: https://github.com/chthollyphile/folia-major

The LX Music integration replaces Folia's application shell, Vite registries,
background system, and player state with a Vue-to-React adapter. The lyric
visualizer algorithms remain derived from the upstream AGPL-3.0 source.

See `LICENSE` in this directory for the full license text.
